hook.text: If only you could conjure some magic to turn manual tasks into smooth systems automatically.
hook.technique_other: wishful 'if only' hypothetical voiced over an overwhelmed illustrated character and chaotic office (pain shown, wish spoken)

summary.tone: Playful, high-energy and whimsical: a hand-drawn-feeling magic/wizard metaphor with rapid on-twos cuts, bold flat illustration and a confident, punchy voice-over that ends on a wry tagline.

signature_moments.description: The sun over the city morphs into an on/off toggle that switches on during 'automatically', and its knob drops out of the toggle onto the tower and bounces into the chaotic office.
signature_moments.why_premium: One shape carries the product idea (automation switched on) across scenes, so the transition is the message; that continuity of objects across cuts is costly to design and reads as authored, not templated.

signature_moments.description: The funnel becomes a magician's hat: pressed, flipped, it produces a dollar coin that spins into a clock, then lands as a wizard hat on a winking character on 'Like a wizard'.
signature_moments.why_premium: A single centred object transforms on each spoken phrase (processes, profits, wizard), giving tight word-to-picture sync and a visual payoff rather than literal icons.

signature_moments.description: The chaos stops on a clean teal card 'Automation isn't magic', then the orange underscore bar appears alone and resolves into the zapier lockup on 'It's Zapier.'
signature_moments.why_premium: The script calls back to the opening 'conjure some magic' and the frantic pace drops to calm, restrained type; building the logo from its own brand mark is an economical, ownable logo resolve.

hook.evidence: Opens instantly on an expressive character whose face cycles through stress while work icons orbit it, under a relatable 'If only you could conjure some magic' wish; strong curiosity and pain, but no bold claim or product in the first seconds.

clarity.evidence: The arc (manual chaos, switch on, magic results, 'Automation isn't magic. It's Zapier.') is easy to follow, but the benefits are abstract metaphors (beams of cursors, envelopes, a funnel, a coin) and the video never shows what Zapier actually does or how it works.

ui_showcase.evidence: No product UI appears anywhere; it is a fully illustrated brand spot, so a UI showcase score does not apply.

motion_polish.evidence: Cel-style vector animation with boiling lines, stepped on-twos rays, squash-and-stretch, a stepped camera pull-out and object continuity across cuts (sun to toggle to knob, cone to funnel to hat); many 2-4 frame cuts are deliberate energy accents and the end slows to calm type and a logo resolve.

sound_design.evidence: From the anchors: a driving 143.55 BPM track at -15.41 LUFS integrated, and 15 SFX candidates including impacts at roughly 2.5 s intervals (x006 11.09 s, x007 13.59 s, x008 16.09 s, x009 18.60 s, x010 21.07 s, x014 26.09 s, x015 28.58 s) that land on phrase starts, the brand name and the end card, plus chimes during the magic beats. Visually the cuts and bursts are paced to these hits. Judged from the audio facts, not by listening; impact labels are partly uncertain (CLAP often says music).

vo_script_quality.evidence: Tight 51-word script with a clear magic metaphor that opens on 'conjure some magic' and closes with the twist 'Automation isn't magic. It's Zapier.'; the middle benefit list (collect leads, notify sales, convert customers, processes into profits) is rhythmic but generic.

brand_consistency.evidence: The zapier wordmark stays top-right through the illustrated shots, the code-measured six-colour palette is used throughout, one consistent outlined flat illustration style, and the end card builds the logo from its own orange underscore bar.

works_muted.evidence: With sound off the chaos-to-magic-to-money story and the closing 'Automation isn't magic' card and 'Start automating for free' end card still come through, but the specific benefits (leads, sales team, customers, profits) are only spoken and there are no captions.

overall.evidence: A highly crafted, on-brand 30 s illustrated spot with excellent motion and a memorable bookended script; it sells a feeling (automation as effortless magic) rather than explaining the product, and shows no UI.

localization_friendliness.notes: Baked-in text is limited to the corner wordmark, one two-line title card (s044) and the end-card tagline (s045), all on flat backgrounds and easy to re-typeset. The benefit list relies on the voice-over, so each market needs a new VO, timed so the visual changes still land on the beats; the illustration itself has no text to translate.

annotation.focal_element: Tilted close-up of an illustrated character's round face (orange sweater) with work icons (envelope, pie chart, hourglass, arrows, papers) orbiting around it
annotation.typography: Only the persistent top-right brand wordmark: lowercase, bold geometric sans, tight tracking, preceded by a short underscore-like bar; no other text.
annotation.what_happens: Over the opening line 'If only you could conjure some magic' (w0-w6) the stressed character's face cycles expressions (smile, grimace with tongue out, sweat drop, wince) while flat office icons (envelopes, pie charts, hourglass, arrows, documents) fly and rotate around the head, conveying overwhelm by manual tasks.
annotation.build_rebuild: Render a full-bleed flat outlined SVG character head on a solid background, swap face-feature groups on a ~0.5s cadence, and animate 5-6 icon sprites along looping rotate+translate paths around the head with a fixed corner wordmark overlay.

The last sampled frame (4.5s) already shows the building exterior, so the cut may fall slightly before the anchor boundary.
annotation.build_rebuild: Compose a static flat office background layer and loop simple arm-raise cycles on each character while icon sprites follow short parabolic hops between desks, all in one full-bleed frame.

annotation.what_happens: New scene: a centered funnel/cone (like an ice-cream cone or magic hat flipped) with lightning bolts shooting up from its rim. The keyframe shows a bare cone with narrow bolts; the sheet frame at 18.5 s already shows a lime starburst behind the rim, a pink bag above and a pie-chart icon near the logo, so the burst grows within the shot. The x009 impact SFX (18.60 s) lands in this shot.
annotation.build_rebuild: Cut to a centered cone with a lime ellipse top on navy, then scale lavender/cream lightning polygons and a lime spiky starburst up from the rim over ~4 frames, timed to an impact SFX.

annotation.shot_type_other: flat 2D vector illustration animation (outlined shapes, character and icon objects)
annotation.focal_element: Centered cone with lime starburst rim and a pink shopping bag rising above it
annotation.typography: Persistent brand wordmark top-right: bold lowercase geometric sans with orange bar prefix; a pie-chart icon passes behind/over it
annotation.what_happens: Two-frame step of the funnel eruption: the lime starburst has appeared behind the rim, wide lightning rays fan out, a pink bag pops up from the cone and a pie-chart badge flies toward the top-right corner. Only a keyframe was available.
annotation.build_rebuild: On the second step of the eruption, pop a spiky lime starburst behind the cone rim (scale 0 to 1 with overshoot) and launch a bag and pie-chart sprite upward and outward from the rim.

annotation.shot_type_other: flat 2D vector illustration animation (outlined shapes, character and icon objects)
annotation.focal_element: Cone with a much larger lime starburst and lightning rays filling the frame; bag, hourglass, envelope and pie-chart icons flying out
annotation.typography: Persistent brand wordmark top-right: bold lowercase geometric sans with orange bar prefix
annotation.what_happens: Two-frame step where the framing is pushed in/scaled up: the starburst and rays now cover most of the frame and more objects (hourglass, envelope, pie chart) burst out of the cone. Only a keyframe was available, so whether this is a camera push or object scale is not visible.
annotation.build_rebuild: Scale the whole cone group ~1.2x toward camera and expand the ray polygons to the frame edges while spawning hourglass, envelope and pie-chart sprites from the rim.

annotation.shot_type_other: flat 2D vector illustration animation (outlined shapes, character and icon objects)
annotation.focal_element: Cone funnel crowned by a lime starburst, swallowing/emitting a swirl of envelopes, calendars, cursors, hourglass, pie charts and plus/check badges
annotation.typography: Persistent brand wordmark top-right: bold lowercase geometric sans with orange bar prefix
annotation.what_happens: Held 1.3 s shot under 'convert more customers,' (w34-w36): the cone stays centered while a vortex of work objects (envelopes, calendars, cursors, hourglass, pie charts, bags, check and plus badges) orbits and is drawn into the lime opening; by 20.0 s the view pulls back/tilts so the cone opening reads as a funnel collecting items. Conveys leads being funnelled into customers.
annotation.build_rebuild: Keep a centered cone with lime rim and starburst, and animate ~20 icon sprites on spiral paths that converge into the rim ellipse (scale down and fade as they cross it) over ~1.3 s, with lightning rays slowly rotating behind.

annotation.shot_type_other: flat 2D vector illustration animation (outlined shapes, icon objects)
annotation.focal_element: Close, low framing of the cream cone/funnel with a lime rim and spiky lime starburst, shopping bags and a document sinking into its opening
annotation.typography: Persistent brand wordmark top-right: bold lowercase geometric sans, tight tracking, with an orange underscore-like bar before it; no other text
annotation.what_happens: 8-frame closer view of the funnel at the end of 'convert more customers,' (after w36 ends, no speech in this window): bags and a document drop into the lime opening while a cursor arrow, plus/check badges, a pie chart and a pink envelope fly out along lavender and cream jagged rays on a navy field. One motion event is counted. Only a keyframe was available (no contact sheet), so the motion inside the shot is not visible.
annotation.build_rebuild: Scale the cone group up so its rim fills the upper half, and tween bag and document sprites down into the rim ellipse (masked by it) while badge, cursor and envelope sprites fly outward along the ray polygons.

annotation.shot_type_other: flat 2D vector illustration animation (outlined shapes, icon objects)
annotation.focal_element: The cone on a flat lavender field, either wide with an orange cap-like shape pressed on its rim (sheet frame) or close with items bursting from its lime rim (keyframe)
annotation.typography: Persistent brand wordmark top-right: bold lowercase geometric sans with orange bar prefix; in the keyframe a flying icon overlaps the wordmark
annotation.what_happens: 2-frame transition beat as the background switches from navy to lavender. The two images disagree: the 20.5 s sheet frame shows a smaller centred cone with an orange cap/hand shape on top, a navy spiky halo and small lightning sparks, while the keyframe shows a close cone with navy rays and an hourglass, envelope, bags, calendar and badges bursting out. Reads as a fast mixed-frame hand-off into the next scene; exact motion not visible.
annotation.build_rebuild: Hard-cut the background from navy to lavender for 2 frames while the cone scales down from close-up to mid-frame and its contents burst outward, setting up the hand pressing on the cone.

annotation.shot_type_other: flat 2D vector illustration animation (outlined shapes, character and icon objects)
annotation.focal_element: The cone as a magic hat: pressed by a hand, flipped, turning a coin into a clock, then landing as a wizard hat on a smiling character's head
annotation.typography: Persistent brand wordmark top-right: bold lowercase geometric sans with orange bar prefix; no other text
annotation.what_happens: 5.3 s centred magic-trick sequence on flat lavender under 'and turn your processes into profits. Like a wizard.' (w37-w45): a hand presses down on the cone (21.0 s), the cone turns lime with a navy rim and flips over like a magician's hat (21.5-22.0 s), lightning bolts drop out of the small hovering hat (22.5 s), a gold dollar coin appears beneath it on 'profits' (23.0 s), the coin spins edge-on revealing a clock face and then a thin edge with a hand (23.5-24.0 s), a round smiling character in a zig-zag sweater pops up with hands raised (24.5-25.0 s) and the lime hat lands on its head as it winks on 'wizard' (25.5 s). Sparkles, x/plus badges and small bolts pop around each object; 4 motion events counted and impact/chime SFX (x010-x013) fall in this shot.
annotation.build_rebuild: On a flat lavender stage keep a lime cone 'hat' centred at the top and sequence object reveals below it on each phrase (coin pop with overshoot, a scaleX flip of the coin to reveal a clock face, then a character pop), finishing by tweening the hat down onto the character's head with a wink swap and small sparkle bursts on each change.

annotation.focal_element: Two-line centred statement 'Automation isn't magic' on a flat teal field
annotation.typography: Large centred two-line headline in a medium-bold grotesque sans, sentence case, tight tracking and tight leading, dark ink; low-confidence guess Zapier's brand sans (Degular-like). The corner wordmark is no longer shown.
annotation.what_happens: After the crossfade the background turns teal and only the small lime hat remains at upper-left (26.0 s); then the headline 'Automation isn't magic' appears centred with sparkles, small lines and a pink lightning bolt scattered around it (26.5 s), and the decorations clear so the text holds alone (27.0-27.5 s). VO says the same words (w46-w48); an impact SFX (x014) lands near the text reveal.
annotation.build_rebuild: Crossfade to a flat teal frame, exit the leftover hat sprite, then reveal the two-line headline on the first spoken word with a quick burst of sparkle and bolt sprites that scale out and disappear within ~0.5 s, holding the clean text to the end of the shot.

annotation.focal_element: Centred '_zapier' logo lockup with the tagline 'Start automating for free' below
annotation.typography: Wordmark: large heavy lowercase geometric sans with an orange underscore bar leading it; tagline: small medium-weight sans, sentence case, normal tracking, centred under the wordmark.
annotation.what_happens: End card on the same teal: the orange underscore bar appears alone (28.0 s), then the full 'zapier' wordmark and the tagline 'Start automating for free' resolve beside and under it by 28.5 s as the VO says 'It's Zapier.' (w49-w50), timed to an impact SFX (x015); the lockup holds to 30.0 s. The incoming whip comes from the anchors; the motion of the whip itself is not visible in the 2 fps stills.
annotation.build_rebuild: After a whip transition onto teal, draw the orange bar first at centre-left, then reveal the wordmark to its right (mask wipe from the bar) and fade up the tagline below on the brand-name word, holding the lockup about 1.5 s.
